fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects cmstp loading "dll" or "ocx" files from suspicious locations
fields.name: DLL Loaded From Suspicious Location Via Cmspt.EXE
fields.query: event.type="ModuleLoad" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\cmstp.exe" and (module.path contains "\PerfLogs\" or module.path contains "\ProgramData\" or module.path contains "\Users\" or module.path contains "\Windows\Temp\" or module.path contains "C:\Temp\") and (module.path contains ".dll" or module.path contains ".ocx")))
